// ILA LOADER v1 - loads the latest Ila code from Accent's GitHub. Do not edit.
var ILA_CODE_URL = 'https://bullpranav-code.github.io/instagram-automation/ila/code/Ila_v4.txt';
function load_() {
  if (globalThis.__ILA_READY) return;
  var c = CacheService.getScriptCache(), code = c.get('ila_code');
  if (!code) {
    var r = UrlFetchApp.fetch(ILA_CODE_URL + '?t=' + Date.now(), { muteHttpExceptions: true });
    if (r.getResponseCode() !== 200) throw new Error('Could not load Ila code (' + r.getResponseCode() + ')');
    code = r.getContentText();
    try { c.put('ila_code', code, 600); } catch (e) {}
  }
  (0, eval)(code);
  globalThis.__ILA_READY = true;
}
function doGet(e) { load_(); return doGet(e); }
function doPost(e) { load_(); return doPost(e); }
function startSession(f) { load_(); return startSession(f); }
function chat(r) { load_(); return chat(r); }
function requestService(r) { load_(); return requestService(r); }
function processDrafts() { load_(); return processDrafts(); }
function feedback(r) { load_(); return feedback(r); }
function setup() { load_(); return setup(); }
function refreshCode() { CacheService.getScriptCache().remove('ila_code'); load_(); Logger.log('Ila code reloaded.'); }
